note: Langlade County campground on Jack Lake northeast of Antigo, in mature maple, birch, oak and pine beside Veterans Memorial Park (beach, playground, disc golf). Direct access to the Ice Age Trail, mountain-bike and ski trails, and the county ATV/UTV and snowmobile trails. Sites 7-15 and 50-57 are on the lake; 49-57 (the former South Shore area) take one camping unit and no tents. Three sleeping cabins. --Claude
summary: County page + all 56 site pages + campground map read. 57 sites (48 electric 20/30A, 9 non-electric), showers/flush/dump/fill station, online-only reservations; season May 15-Oct 12 (was 05-01..10-15 derived); fees now $40 (non-electric lakeside) / $45 every electric site (stored $45-50 weekend lakeside premium gone). Not waterfront stored vs engine 'Lakefront: Yes' on 16 sites -> lakeview lead. Pin ~300 m off (memorial park lawn). Phone/name flags.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up, not waterfront -> lakeview): the county's per-site pages tag 'Lakefront: Yes' on sites 7-15 (electric) and 50-57 (non-electric), and the rate table calls 8-15 and 49-57 'Lakeside Campsites'. On imagery the lakeside pads of the main loop (sites 7-15, ~45.3282,-89.1005 to 45.3281,-89.0990) sit between the north loop road and the shore, ~15-35 m from the water, but under hardwood canopy ('All sites are wooded and shaded') - so not lakefront on open ground; a filtered view from the lakeside sites earns lakeview. Sites 50-57 are along the south lobe of the lake east of the main loop (~45.3276,-89.0975); 52-57 are 18-26 ft wide. All are sold by the night (no seasonal sites).

PIN: stored 45.32820,-89.10400 sits on the Veterans Memorial Park lawn/beach area west of the campground. The main camping loop (sites 1-31) centres at ~45.3276,-89.1002 on imagery (leaf-off), ~300 m east-southeast; move to 45.3276,-89.1002.
NAME: 'Veterans Memorial Park (Jack Lake) Campground' -> 'Jack Lake Campground' (the county's own name; Veteran's Memorial Park is the adjacent day-use park on the map).
PHONE: stored 715-623-6214 appears on no county page read; the department's posted number is (715) 627-6300 (contact page). Suggest 715-623-6214 -> 715-627-6300.

FEES: stored $45-50 (lakeside 8-15 $50 Fri-Sun) is gone - every electric site is now '$45 per day' all days; the non-electric lakeside sites 49-57 are $40 (one camping unit, no tents; generators allowed off quiet hours). Base $40 assumes a 23-ft motorhome fits the narrow 49-57 pads (posted 35x20 to 61x37 ft); the cheapest electric site is $45.
SEASON: written 05-15..10-12 (campsite availability; was 05-01..10-15 derived 'approximate'). No 2027 dates posted.
OHV (general campground, keep): 'Direct access to Langlade County ATV/UTV trail system (100+ miles)' - a general lake campground with trail access, not a staging camp.
SITES: no pad lengths or max rig length posted; the per-site 'Dimensions' (e.g. 50 x 40 ft) are site sizes, so max_rig_ft is not written. Pull-through: site 49 'No'.
